recognize_zh: 骨髓切片與抹片中可見體積巨大的原紅血球 (giant pronormoblasts)，核內呈淡染玻璃樣包涵體、細胞質深藍帶空泡；免疫染色在這些巨大細胞的核膜呈環狀陽性，符合急性小病毒 B19 感染。
features: Panel A: scattered giant erythroid precursors with large nuclei containing glassy, pale-eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions and marginated chromatin
Panel A: relative paucity of maturing erythroid precursors; granulocytic cells present
Panel B: giant proerythroblast with abundant deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and large round nucleus
Panel C: IHC with strong nuclear rim/whole-nucleus staining in enlarged cells (consistent with parvovirus B19 antigen)
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows scattered giant erythroid precursors with large nuclei containing glassy intranuclear viral inclusions and peripherally condensed chromatin, with few maturing erythroid forms. The aspirate shows giant proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry highlights the enlarged cells with a nuclear rim/nuclear pattern consistent with parvovirus B19 capsid antigen. Findings are consistent with acute parvovirus B19 infection with erythroid hypoplasia.

ddx.vs: Leukemic proerythroblasts form sheets without intranuclear glassy inclusions and are negative for parvovirus IHC/PCR, with TP53 alterations.
Megaloblastic marrow shows erythroid hyperplasia across all maturation stages with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes, not isolated giant pronormoblasts with inclusions.

ddx.dx: Thymoma- or drug-associated pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Non-viral PRCA lacks giant pronormoblasts with viral inclusions and is negative for parvovirus B19 staining.
